_about: The periodic health tasks of 'Periodic Health Tasks Checklist' (15 Nov 2026): how, how often, why. everyDays = repeat interval; missionDays = fixed mission days (negative = days before return). Proposals are marked in 'frequency'. Limits live in thresholds.json.

tasks.label: Eye examination
tasks.frequency: Full exam on mission day 30 and 90 and 30 days before return; vision test monthly (proposal); eye pressure only on complaint
tasks.why: Slow eye changes on long missions (SANS) are caught early.

tasks.label: Blood and urine tests
tasks.frequency: Blood monthly, urine specific gravity weekly (proposal)
tasks.why: Anaemia, salt and mineral imbalance, hidden infection and dehydration (kidney stone risk) show early.

tasks.label: Cognitive performance test
tasks.frequency: Every 2–3 weeks, same time of day; about 11 times on a 6-month mission
tasks.why: Fatigue and short sleep lower attention and reaction time; people rarely notice it themselves.

tasks.label: Reaction time test
tasks.frequency: With every cognitive test (every 2–3 weeks, same time of day), and after a short night or when confused (proposal)
tasks.why: Short sleep, stress and cabin CO₂ slow reaction time; a tired person usually thinks they are fine, so it is measured.

tasks.label: Nutrition and fluid intake
tasks.why: Eating too little is common in space; too little water raises kidney stone risk.

tasks.label: Medication use
tasks.why: Sleep medication is used about 10 times more than on Earth; side effects and stock are tracked.

tasks.label: Detailed symptom diary
tasks.frequency: Every evening; reviewed before the weekly private medical conference
tasks.why: Small complaints adding up can be the first sign of a serious problem.

tasks.label: ECG rhythm analysis
tasks.why: Rhythm problems can start without symptoms.

tasks.label: Body mass
tasks.frequency: Weekly (proposal); twice a week when yellow, daily when red
tasks.why: Weight loss usually comes from eating too little and progresses unnoticed.

tasks.label: Aerobic fitness test
tasks.why: Endurance for spacewalks and emergency egress can fall.

tasks.label: Muscle strength test
tasks.why: Strength loss is not felt in space but causes injuries at landing and on the surface.

tasks.label: Sleep tracking
tasks.why: Sleep debt builds up and leads to errors, poor attention and memory.
